rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when the context makes clear that you mean one item of clothing.

example.english: This garment fits you really well.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 ngaam1 nei5 zoek3

rows.note: Use this more general term when you want to refer explicitly to clothing rather than the everyday catch-all 衫.

example.english: Before the trip, remember to pack the garment.
example.traditional: 去旅行前，記得帶件衣服。
example.jyutping: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 cin4 gei3 dak1 daai3 gin6 ji1 fuk6
